system.description:
A storm cloud forms overhead, crackling and ready to strike wherever you point. On later turns while this spell lasts, you can call down a bolt at a point you can see within range; each creature within 5 feet of that point takes lightning damage.

Scaling: At dice count 3, the damage increases substantially. At dice count 6, you can call down two bolts at different points with a single action. At dice count 9, the storm also creates heavy rain that douses flames and obscures vision in the area. At dice count 12, you can call a bolt as a reaction. At dice count 15, every bolt you call strikes all valid targets in the area, not just one.
